NFL 2025 - week one team charter flights

Posted on Wednesday, September 3, 2025 by Doug Kroll
Topics: NFL

Here's this week's NFL team charter flight schedule. If you're an aviation enthusiast who'd like alerts when unusual aircraft visit your airport, check out JetTip's smart flight alert service.

Nick Benson - JetTip.net

The Cardinals play New Orleans this week, and will likely be aboard N777AZ, one of their 777-200s.
